Daily Devotional

May 24

4 But as we were allowed of God to be put in trust with the gospel, even so we speak; not as pleasing men, but God, which trieth our hearts. (1 Thessalonians 2:4 KJV)

It is amazing that God would trust us to be the ones to teach His Gospel. This means that man is the only one that has the authority to teach the True Gospel of Jesus Christ, and if we don’t share it with others, then they will not hear it, as not even the Angels are able to preach the Gospel of Jesus. Wow, that gives us a very large responsibility to share the Good News of the Gospel with all those that we come into contact with (Mark 16:15-16). We must remember that God has limited Himself to having to flow through people (Ephesians 3:20), so the Holy Spirit must have people to believe and witness for Him, so that He can do His work of bringing people to Christ.

One reason that Paul was so successful in preaching the Gospel was that he was not one to try and please man, but only was looking to please God. Many preachers today are more interested in pleasing the Church members, than they are in pleasing God, so they teach what people want to hear, and not what they need to hear. We need to teach the true Word of God, with love, but without compromise, as people need to know what God is saying, and need to know God, so that they can be in fellowship with the Lord. You can’t fellowship with someone you don’t know or understand. Praise God for Jesus, the Holy Spirit and for all the Apostles and Prophets that gave us God’s Word.

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
